claims.text: The name Ivárë is Qenya, but its meaning is unclear. Its Gnomish cognate is Ior.
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, "I-Lam na-Ngoldathon: The Grammar and Lexicon of the Gnomish Tongue", in Parma Eldalamberon XI (edited by Christopher Gilson, Arden R. Smith, and Patrick H. Wynne), p. 51

claims.text:
In The Lay of Leithian, the three greatest Elven minstrels are mentioned again as Tinfang, Dairon and Maglor; Maglor was a later change from an earlier draft, in which he replaced Ivárë.
